_README: MASTER TUNING FILE. Change numbers here; no code needed. Restart the game to see changes.
game  = numbers that used to be written in the code (player base stats, stamina, monster rewards, respawns, spawns, item formulas, prices, arena).
files = overrides for the other files in data/. Anything written here WINS over the same value in that file (e.g. files > progression.json > scaling > hpExp).
Objects merge key by key; a list [ ... ] replaces the whole list. Only the values listed here are overridden; the rest of each file still applies.
Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored. Keep commas between entries and no comma after the last one, or the game cannot read the file (an error is logged).
Current values below are the game's values as of 2026-11-11.

game._darkSoulsHelp: Dark Souls combat pass (2026-11-27, not yet play tested): hitbox, poise, roll, backstep, parry, backstab, lock, life, move, death, enemyAtk, rm, feel below. Code: PlayerCombat.cs, EnemyStrike.cs, Hitbox.cs (/hitbox draws them), AvatarMotion.cs, HeroPose.cs.

hitbox._help: Swept weapon hitboxes (Hitbox.cs). activeBefore / activeAfter: the live window around a swing's hit moment (fractions of the swing) unless an attack sets 'active': [start, end]. bladeRadius: thickness of a blade (m); heavyHeadExtra: more for maces, axes, hammers; fistRadius / knuckles: fists (forearm to knuckles); slack: forgiveness added to every hitbox. thrustTip: share of the blade (from the tip) that hurts on thrusts (rapier, spear, thrust steps). gripBack: the edge starts this far below the blade's base mark. cleaveExtra: the Cleave passive lengthens the cut. sweepStep / sweepMaxSteps: a frame's movement is tested in steps no longer than this (no tunnelling). wallRecoil 1 = heavy weapons rebound off stone walls (wallRecoilTime s flinch). armReach: arm length added to the blade for the step-in; magnetReachK: the step-in stops at this share of the real reach from the foe's edge; magnetMax: it never closes more than this (m); magnetSpeed: m/s. heroHeight / heroCrouchHeight / heroRadius: the hero's hurtbox; petHeight / petRadius: a pet's. bendChest / bendMax / bendUp: the back bends toward a low foe during a swing (radians). biteMin: smallest jaw hitbox.

poise._help: Poise (PlayerCombat.cs, EnemyStrike.cs). Hero: heroBase + armor defense x heroPerDefense, at most heroMax. Monsters: their own 'poise' in data/enemies.json, else enemyBase x (height / 1.9 m)^1.5, x bossMul for bosses, x slamMul for slammers. A blow's poise damage: hero weapons by class (weapon.<class>, else 7 light / 12 one-handed / 18 heavy / 26 two-handed / 5 fists), x powerMul / finisherMul, x offHandMul for off-hand swings; spells 'spell'; criticals 'critical'. Monster blows: their 'poiseDmg', else enemyHitBase x height factor (x slamHitMul). Broken poise: a stagger of staggerLight s (Hit_Chest, Hit_Head when struck at head height or from heavyFromAbove... headFromAbove m above) or staggerHeavy s (Hit_Knockback, pushed knockback m/s) when the blow did at least heavyHit. Hyper-armour (heavy / two-handed / power swings from hyperFrom of the wind-up to the end of the active window; slamming monsters late in the wind-up, enemyHyperFrom of it left, and through the strike) takes only hyperMul of poise damage. Poise refills regenShare of the bar a second, regenDelay s after the last blow.

roll._help: The dodge roll (PlayerCombat.cs): lasts time s and covers dist m (with Roll_RM's own travel timing once it is baked); it is invincible only from iStart to iEnd s after it starts (was: the whole 0.45 s roll at 11 m/s), so a blow before or after lands.

backstep._help: Dodge with no direction held: a short hop back (attack animation 'backstep' = Shield_Dash_RM played backwards, data/avatar.json) of dist m over time s, invincible iStart..iEnd s, costing stamina (x the Agility roll multiplier), cooldown s. on 0 = a no-direction dodge rolls forward as before.

parry._help: A parried humanoid reels stun s and can be riposted meanwhile (beasts reel beastStun s, no riposte): attack within riposteRange m, inside riposteCone degrees of your aim, for a critical blow x riposteMul (animation: data/attacks.json critical.anim). The struck foe is held critHold s past the blow; the hero is untouchable during it. The parry window itself: guard.parryWindow (crossed blades: weapons.json dual.parryWindow).

backstab._help: A light attack on a humanoid that is not hunting you, from within cone degrees of straight behind it and range m: a critical blow x mul (the riposte animation).

lock._help: Lock-on strafing: the legs turn into the step by at most legMax degrees off the foe, the torso and head twist back by torsoShare of that (HeroPose); moving more than backpedalFrom degrees away from the foe backpedals.

life._help: Procedural life over the run clips (HeroPose.cs): the back leans accelLean rad per m/s2 of forward acceleration (at most accelLeanMax, smoothed accelSmooth /s), the head keeps headStab of it level; armSwingExtra = how much wider the arms swing when the body outruns the clip's top rate.

move._help: Ground acceleration of the hero in m/s2 while speeding up (accel) and slowing down (decel); was 40 both ways (full run in 0.14 s). Lower = heavier starts and stops.

death._help: The hero's Death01 plays at a random rate rateMin..rateMax with a blend of blendMin..blendMax s, so no two falls look the same.

enemyAtk._help: Monster blows (EnemyStrike.cs). windPause: seconds a humanoid holds the top of its wind-up (beastPause for the rest; a monster's own 'windPause' in data/enemies.json wins). active: seconds the strike's hitbox is live (x slamActiveMul for slams; a monster's own 'active' wins). lead: the strike opens this long before the clip's hit moment. strikeTurn: how fast it still turns during the strike (/s). Hitbox without a weapon or jaws: a sphere from sphereFrom of its reach out to the full reach, radius sphereScale x its radius (at least sphereMin), at strikeHeight of its height; an animated model's head bone, headAhead x radius in front, radius headRadius x its radius.

rm._help: Root motion of attack clips cut from _RM clips (Sword_Dash_RM, Shield_Dash_RM): the clip's own travel x attackScale, at most attackMax m (needs the re-bake; until then the step curve, game.attack.step*).

feel._help: On contact the swing (the model and the attack timeline together) slows to pauseSlow for pauseTime s: x pauseTwoHanded for two-handed weapons, x pauseLight for daggers and fists, x pauseHeavyMul for heavy, power, finisher and critical blows. Works online (the global hit-stop in data/feel.json impact does not).

fastTravel._help: Map fast travel: seconds between jumps, and how close (metres) a hunting enemy blocks it.

guard._help: Shield guard: parryWindow = seconds after pressing guard that a blow is parried (no damage, foe stunned parryStun s, next hit within riposteTime s deals riposteMul x). Blocks give hitStop s, pushBack m, sparks.
guard._breakHelp: Dark Souls pass: breakStagger 0.6 -> 1.1 s, the guard break plays Idle_Shield_Break (Player.TakeHit)

player._help: Hero base stats. Max health = hpBase + level x hpPerLevel + Vitality x hpPerVit (+ gear, tree). Mana, stamina likewise. defensePerVit: armor per Vitality. critBase 0.05 = 5%. critDamage 1.8 = crits deal 180%. weaponBase: flat damage every weapon hit starts from (magicWeaponBase for wands and staves). spellPerMag / spellPerLevel: spell power per Magic / level. Regen per second. Potions heal this share of max health / mana. combatStanceSeconds: how long the hero keeps the guarded weapon stance after fighting (then stands relaxed).

perfectDodge._help: Perfect dodge: a blow that would land within window seconds of starting a roll is avoided with slow motion (slowScale for slowTime real seconds) and a counter window (counterTime s) where the next melee hit does counterMul x damage. cooldown: seconds before another can trigger.

stamina._help: Stamina cost of each action. Sprint drain and refill speed are in files > feel.json > move. twoHandedMul / daggerMul scale melee costs for two-handed weapons and daggers. blockPerDamage: stamina lost per point of damage blocked.
stamina._sprintHelp: A-02. sprintResume: when the bar runs empty while sprinting the hero drops to a jog and cannot sprint again until stamina is back to this many points (at most half the bar); before, the sprint flickered on and off around 1 stamina and the bar never refilled while the key was held. padSprintDrop: a controller's toggled run switches itself off after the hero has not actually been sprinting for this many seconds (attacking, guarding, sneaking, riding, staggered), and at once when out of breath.
stamina._minHelp: Dark Souls pass: an attack, a roll or a backstep needs at least minToAct stamina (was: 4 for an attack, 85% of the roll's cost for a roll); at 0 nothing but walking.

attack._help: A-03, the weight of basic attacks (Player.TryAttack). A swing lasts: its dur in data/weapons.json x swingMul x the class factor below, divided by attack speed x the weapon's speed x the chain step's speed. Class factor: twoHandedSwingMul for two-handed melee (greatsword, spear), lightWeaponSwingMul for daggers and fists, rangedSwingMul for bows, wands and staves, 1 for the rest; power (heavy) attacks x powerSwingMul on top. Before A-03 all of these were 1 (swingMul 1.65 = every swing 65% longer). After the swing comes the recovery pause from data/attacks.json 'recovery' (also divided by attack speed), during which the next swing cannot start; a press made meanwhile is kept (bufferSwing: at most this many seconds of the swing still to go, plus the whole recovery). Attack speed from stats, gear, buffs and skills still shortens swing and recovery, counted up to maxSpeed (x2.5); no swing is shorter than minSwing seconds and no recovery shorter than minRecover. recClipMin: recoveries longer than this play the follow-through animation (finishers, power attacks); shorter ones let the swing animation play out.
attack._stepHelp: Dark Souls pass (PlayerCombat.cs SwingStep): metres each swing carries the body forward (smoothstep from half the wind-up to the end of the active window, or the clip's own root motion for _RM clips: game.rm). Light / finisher / power; x twoHandedMul for two-handed, x lightWeaponMul for daggers and fists. A step in data/attacks.json or weapons.json ('step') wins. stepStopGap: no step once the foe is this close. rollCancelAfter: a swing can be rolled out of only after its active window plus this share of the swing.

melee._help: A-04, height reach of melee blows (Combat.cs Melee.Reaches), for monsters hitting heroes and pets and for the hero's own swings. Heights are feet to head in metres; the hero counts at the height they stand on (a jump does not lift them out of reach, a ledge does). A blow reaches when attacker and target stand within stepTolerance of each other (slopes, slabs: under one block). An attacker taller than bodyHeight reaches reachPerHeight further for each extra metre (a 4 m golem: 0.75 + 2.1 x 0.6 = 2 m up). Striking down reaches downExtra further (one block down: yes; two: no), plus targetPerHeight for each metre the lower target is taller than bodyHeight. crowdGap: a monster that cannot reach walks on until this close (metres from its edge) and waits instead of swinging. Before A-04: monsters ignored height entirely; the hero hit anything within 3.5 m up or down.

time._help: A-06, length of the day (World.DayPace). The clock runs at dayPace in daylight and nightPace at night: each is the seconds a whole day-and-night would take at that pace, blended smoothly over dawn and dusk by the sun's height. Before A-06 both were 720 (a 12 minute day: about 6 minutes of daylight, 6 of night). Now the sun is up for about 17.5 minutes and down for a little over 6 (a whole day about 23.5 minutes). Quest timers, bounties, respawns and weather run on real seconds and are not affected; villagers follow the clock, so their daytime hours are now 90 s each instead of 30.

monsters._help: Rewards and respawns for every monster (stats and scaling are under files > enemies.json and files > progression.json). xp = base xp x (1 + xpPerLevel x (level-1)) x xpMul. Killing a monster more than lowLevelGap levels below you gives lowLevelXp of the xp. Gold = random between goldMin + level x goldMinPerLevel and goldMax + level x goldMaxPerLevel, x goldMul (bosses x bossGoldMul). itemChance: chance a normal monster drops an item (+ shadowItemChance in the Shadow realm, + upgradeItemChance per dungeon upgrade). Loot bonus raises rarity. respawn: seconds before an overworld monster comes back.

world._help: Area level = 1 + distance from Oakhaven / metresPerAreaLevel (+ shadowAreaBonus in the Shadow realm), at most maxAreaLevel. Overworld monsters are at least this level (they also follow your level: files > progression.json > overworld). lightCamps / shadowCamps: monster camps placed on the island when the world is built.

items._help: Item stats: [base, perLevel] -> (base + item level x perLevel) x rarity multiplier (files > items.json > rarityMult). Weapons: dmg for every type; wands and staves get less damage (wandDamageMul, staffDamageMul) but spell power (wandSpell, staffSpell, as a share: 0.06 = +6%). Hands give damage and trinkets defense only at Rare or better.

shop._help: Brynn's prices. Items cost value x buyMul + buyAdd (they sell for their value).

arena._help: Wave Survival: foes per wave = foesBase + wave x foesPerWave (at most maxFoes); foe level = your level + wave x levelsPerWave - 1. healBetweenWaves: share of max health restored after each wave. Valor rewards: files > valor.json.

duel._help: Shadow Duel boss (scripts/EnemyDuelist.cs), a mirror of the hero. Health = the larger of hero max health x hpPerHeroHp and hero weapon damage x hpPerWeaponHit, +hpPerRound each round. Its blows are a share of the hero's max health (armour counts half), +damagePerRound each round. speed (m/s, +speedPerRound, at most maxSpeed); wind-ups get quickerPerRound shorter (at least minWindMul). stance = share of its health that breaks its stance (brokenTime seconds kneeling, brokenTaken x damage); parryStance = share of the stance a parry takes; it recovers stanceRegen of it per second after stanceRegenDelay. dodgeChance / dodgeCooldown: how often it sidesteps a swing. Phases at phase2At / phase3At health; each opens with the Eclipse: break a barrier of (hero weapon damage x eclipseHitsPerSecond x seconds x eclipseShare) within eclipseTime2 / eclipseTime3 seconds or take eclipseDamage x max health as true damage (a roll avoids it) while it heals eclipseHeal. Phase 3 hits enrageDamage harder. healBetweenRounds: share of your health restored after a won round.

progression.json._help: Levelling and monster scaling. See the _help notes inside data/progression.json for every field.

scaling._help: Monsters measured against a reference hero of their level (see scaling._help in data/progression.json). The old hpLin/hpExp/dmgLin/dmgExp curve is gone.

enemies.json._help: Monster base stats at level 1 (they grow with the scaling above). hp, dmg per blow, xp, spd (m/s), aggro (distance they notice you), cd (seconds between attacks), armor, mr (magic resist). More fields per monster in data/enemies.json.

loot.json._help: Drop rarity: weights for Common, Fine, Rare, Epic, Legendary; each point of loot bonus shifts weight toward rarer items (bonusPerPoint). Dungeon floors add bonusPerDepth per floor and bonusPerTier per 5-floor tier. Set gear: first floor (minDepth) and drop chances per kill (normal, upgraded 'elite', boss), +perDepth per floor deeper. Per-dungeon tables, uniques, scraps and crafting costs: data/loot.json.

items.json._help: Stat multiplier per rarity: Common, Fine, Rare, Epic, Legendary.

feel.json._help: Movement: run / sprint speed (m/s; if you change these, change avatar.json gait run/sprint by the same ratio so legs match), sprint stamina drain per second, delay before stamina refills, refill per second.
feel.json._moveDs: 2026-11-27 animation pass: run 5.6 -> 4.6 and sprint 8.0 -> 6.6 m/s (the pre-2026-11-11 values), so the legs match the ground: at 5.6 the jog clip played at 2.1x (owner: legs far too fast for the speed). Raise them again only together with avatar.json gait (see the '[AVATAR] strides' log line).

valor.json._help: Arena currency. Valor for clearing milestone waves, Shadow Duel rounds (duelPerRound x streak, at most duelMax), gacha pull costs.

wildlife.json._help: Animal herds: groups = herds on the island, size = [min, max] animals per herd.
